Method of Attack: Cache-Poisoned Denial of Service (CPDoS) via malformed HTTP request headers causing caching of error pages
Discoverer: Hoai Viet Nguyen, Luigi Lo Iacono, and Hannes Federrath from Cologne University of Applied Sciences and University of Hamburg
Attack Vector: Malformed HTTP request headers including HTTP Header Oversize (HHO), HTTP Meta Character (HMC), HTTP Method Override (HMO)
Indicators of Compromise: Cached error pages such as '400 Bad Request' served instead of valid resources
